content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal provide a convenient, all-in-one solution for accepting payments. They handle the technical complexities of payment processing, including secure transactions, fraud detection, and chargeback management. However, their services come at a cost, often with subscription fees and transaction fees that can eat into your profits, especially if you're selling high-value items like plugins. On the other hand, building your own commerce stack using tools like Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments gives you complete control over your infrastructure. You decide on the tech stack, the payment methods, and the user experience. While this approach requires more upfront work, it offers long-term benefits like cost-effectiveness, flexibility, and ownership of your data and processes.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Payment processors like Stripe and PayPal have a long history of restricting access to their services in certain countries. This is often due to regulatory complexities, political instability, or a high risk of fraud in those regions. For creators in these restricted countries, it can be challenging to find reliable payment processing solutions. Platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, while more inclusive than Stripe and PayPal, also have their limitations. They may not support all cryptocurrencies or offer the same level of customization and control as building your own stack. By contrast, creating your own sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that you're not reliant on any external platform's terms or restrictions. You can accept payments in the currencies of your choice, including cryptocurrencies, and tailor your payment processing to your specific needs and those of your customers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment processors often charge a premium for their services. Stripe, for example, charges a percentage of each transaction (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction) and a monthly subscription fee. While these fees may seem reasonable, they can add up quickly, especially for high-value products like plugins. PayPal, another popular choice, has similar fee structures and can also hold funds for up to 180 days in case of an account suspension, leaving you without access to your own money. In contrast, building your own commerce stack using tools like NOWPayments can significantly reduce these costs. NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee for each transaction, with no hidden costs or monthly fees. Additionally, by accepting cryptocurrencies, you can further reduce fees and offer your customers more payment flexibility. The initial setup costs of building your own stack are higher, but the long-term savings can be substantial.
Build your own commerce stack to gain complete control over your payment processing and customer experience.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When you rely on external payment processors, you're giving up a degree of control over your business. These platforms can change their terms, suspend your account, or even shut down your business without warning. Additionally, their automation tools may not always align with your specific needs, especially if you're selling complex products like plugins. By building your own commerce stack, you own your entire infrastructure. You can automate payment verification, product delivery, and customer communication to fit your exact requirements. Tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers allow for highly customizable automation, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers. With full ownership, you have the freedom to scale, innovate, and adapt your business as needed, without being held back by the limitations of external platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The decision to build your own commerce stack or rely on external payment processors depends on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're a creator in a country with limited payment processing options, building your own stack using tools like Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments gives you the freedom and control to sell your products on your terms. It may require a higher initial investment of time and resources, but the long-term benefits of cost savings, ownership, and flexibility are significant. For creators in countries with more established payment processors, the choice is more nuanced. While external processors offer convenience and a lower initial barrier to entry, the long-term costs and limitations on control should be carefully considered. Ultimately, the decision comes down to your specific business needs, the level of control and customization you require, and the potential for future growth and adaptation.
